title: Copied over something by accident? Get it back! 📋⚡ #Shorts
description:
Copied something new and lost what you copied before? Windows keeps a history of your clipboard, so you can paste any of your recent copies! 🙌

⌨️ Windows: Win + V, then click the item you want (the first time, turn clipboard history on)
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Space, then Cmd + 4 (clipboard history in Spotlight, macOS Tahoe or newer)

Phone: on most Android keyboards, tap the clipboard icon above the keys.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
